title: Boro Ramayana: The Epic of Rama in the Bodo Language
translators: Jyanendra Basumatary (Assam Publication Board edition), Bhaben Narzary & Traditional Folk Rhapsodists

kandas.summary_bodo: राजा दोसोरोथनि पुथ्रो जोनोम, राम, लोखोन, भोरोत आरो सोथ्रुगोननि जोनोम। बिस्वामित्र मुनिनि जोंजों दावबायनाय, थाथोका दैथ्यखौ बुथारनाय आरो सीतानि हाबा (स्वयंवर)।
kandas.summary_en: Birth of Rama, Lakshmana, Bharata and Shatrughna to King Dasharatha. Departure with Sage Vishvamitra, slaying of demoness Tataka, breaking of Shiva's bow and marriage to Sita.

kandas.summary_bodo: राजा दोसोरोथनि रामखौ राजा खालामनो लुबैनाय। कैकेयीनि दाबि आरो रामनि जिब्रै बोसोरनि हाग्रामा दावबायनाय (बोनबास)। दोसोरोथनि जिउ गोमानाय।
kandas.summary_en: Preparations for Rama's coronation, Queen Kaikeyi's boons, Rama's 14-year forest exile, loyalty of Lakshmana and Sita, and passing of King Dasharatha.

kandas.summary_bodo: पञ्चवतीयाव न लुनानै थानाय। सुरपनखानि खुगा-खनथं दाननाय। सोरनानि मैखुनौ नुनानै रामनि थांनाय आरो लंकायाव राबोना सिताखौ खावना लानानै थांनाय।
kandas.summary_en: Dwelling in Panchavati forest, Surpanakha's mutilation, the golden deer illusion, and the abduction of Sita by Ravana, king of Lanka.

kandas.summary_bodo: राम आरो सुग्रीवनि मोजां मोन्नाय (लोगो जानाय)। सुग्रीवनि बिदा बालिखौ बुथारनाय। सीताखौ नागिरनो थाखाय हनुमाननि गिबि दावबायनाय।
kandas.summary_en: Alliance between Rama and Sugriva, slaying of Vali, and dispatching of the Vanara armies led by Hanuman to search for Sita.

kandas.summary_bodo: हनुमाननि लैथो बारनानै लंकायाव सौफैनाय। अशोक बाथियाव सिताखौ नुफैनाय। लंका नगरिखौ अर सानाय आरो रामनाव सितानि रादाब लाबोनाय।
kandas.summary_en: Hanuman's heroic leap across the ocean to Lanka, locating Sita in the Ashoka grove, delivering Rama's ring, burning of Lanka, and returning with Sita's gem.

kandas.summary_bodo: लैथो सायाव दालां (सेतु) लुनाय। राम आरो राबोननि गेजेराव गिदिर दाओहा। राबोनखौ बुथारनाय, सिताखौ रैखा खालामनाय आरो अयोध्यायाव गोजोनै गिदिंगानाय।
kandas.summary_en: Construction of Rama Setu bridge, the great war against Ravana and his forces, slaying of Ravana, rescue of Sita, and victorious return to Ayodhya.

kandas.summary_bodo: अयोध्यायाव रामनि राज्याभिषेक (रामराज्य)। लब आरो कुश पुथ्रो मोन्नाय। वाल्मीकि मुनिनि आश्रम आरो सितानि हामाव हाबलांनाय।
kandas.summary_en: Coronation of Rama, establishment of Ramrajya, birth of Lava and Kusha in Valmiki's hermitage, and Sita's return to Mother Earth.

specimen_passages.context: Rama's obedience to parental vow (पितृ-सत्य पालन)
specimen_passages.bodo_dev:
आफानि बाथ्राखौ फालिनानै आं हाग्रामायाव थांगोन,
जिब्रै बोसोर हाग्रामायाव गोजोनै थागोन आं।
संसारआव धोरमोनि सायाव जेबो गैया,
आफानि रावखौ मानिनायनि सायाव सिमां गैया।
specimen_passages.bodo_rom:
Afani bathrakhwo falinanwi ang hagramayao thanggwn,
Jibrwi bwswr hagramayao gwojwnwi thagwn ang.
Swnsarao dhormoni sayao jebw gwiya,
Afani raokhwo maninayni sayao simang gwiya.
specimen_passages.english:
In faithful fulfillment of my father's solemn word, I shall depart for the deep woods,
Fourteen years shall I dwell content amidst the tranquil wilderness.
In all this mortal world, naught transcends sacred righteousness (Dharma),
And no virtue shines brighter than filial devotion to truth.

specimen_passages.bodo_dev:
आं प्रभु रामनि साखोर, आंनि मुं हनुमान,
लैथो बारनानै फैबाय आं मैनाव सिताखौ नागिरनो।
गिया बाबु, प्रभु राम फैगोन दाओहा जों लंकायाव,
दुखु गासिबो गोजानाव थांगोन नोंनि।
specimen_passages.bodo_rom:
Ang probhu Ramni sakhor, angni mung Honuman,
Lwithw barnanwi fwibay ang Mainao Sitakhwo nagirnw.
Giya babu, probhu Ram fwigwn daoha jwng Lankayao,
Dukhu gasibw gwojanao thanggwn nwhnni.
specimen_passages.english:
I am the humble servant of Lord Rama, my name is Hanuman,
Leaping across the boundless ocean have I arrived to seek Mother Sita.
Fear not, Mother! Lord Rama shall arrive in righteous valor at Lanka's gates,
And every sorrow that burdens thy gentle spirit shall be banished forever.
